svg.aria-label: Voight-Kampff test. Q: A private key, lying in the sand. A: I don't touch it. I build a vault. Q: An agent wants signing authority. A: Granted. It signs nothing. Q: 3 a.m. Who's on call? A: Agents. They wake a human first. Q: Your work, one word each. A: Keys. Thresholds. Proofs. Rain. Result: inconclusive. More human than human.

text.tspan: A private key, lying in the sand.
I don't touch it. I build a vault.
Agents. They wake a human first.
